_comment: What a buildable costs and how long a builder works on it once at the site. Loaded at content bootstrap; the C++ table in game/systems/construction_cost_catalog.cpp is the fallback when this file is missing. Harvest tasks (cut_tree, collect_*) take build_time only. Wall costs must stay in step with WallNetworkService::k_wall_segment_wood_cost / k_wall_gate_wood_cost, which the wall preview quotes.
